GlobalTrace
	

GlobalTrace is a benchmark of GPS trajectories drawn from 73 cities/regions across the world, with masked-segment annotations for evaluating trajectory reconstruction methods. Three masking strategies are provided per trajectory: destination, large_gap, and simple_interpolation (200m gap target).
